summaries.26ccc4de082d73096d91e7b323e03a4bc9390c61: Purpose: Repro of O1 bug 1 (stale helper node counters) over UCI. After a deep multi-thread search the helpers' published node counts stay at their final values. At the next `go nodes N`, the main thread checks the node budget at every node and sums those stale counts before the helpers have reset them, so the search stops before depth 1 completes and the engine plays the first legal move unsearched (no info line). summaries.26ccc4de082d73096d91e7b323e03a4bc9390c61: Purpose: Repro of O1 bug 1 (stale helper node counters) over UCI. After a deep multi-thread search the helpers' published node counts stay at their final values. At the next `go nodes N`, the main thread checks the node budget at every node and sums those stale counts before the helpers have reset them, so the search stops before depth 1 completes and the engine plays the first legal move unsearched (no info line). summaries.26ccc4de082d73096d91e7b323e03a4bc9390c61: Purpose: Repro of O1 bug 1 (stale helper node counters) over UCI. After a deep multi-thread search the helpers' published node counts stay at their final values. At the next `go nodes N`, the main thread checks the node budget at every node and sums those stale counts before the helpers have reset them, so the search stops before depth 1 completes and the engine plays the first legal move unsearched (no info line). Works on the AL1 s198 lock exe; on the O1 build compare SmpExactNodes=false/true. usage: r. Functions: main. Data: KIWI. Python, 47 lines.

Replays every game from its FEN header (or the start position), checks that every move is legal, that the game-ending result is consistent (mate / stalemate / 50-move / repetition / insufficient material / adjudication), and classifies terminations. Any illegal move, crash ("disconnect", "abandoned"), hang/missing bestmove ("stall", "timeout", "time forfeit" beyond the time margin) is reported; exit 1 on any. Functions: main. Python, 75 lines.
summaries.26ccc4de082d73096d91e7b323e03a4bc9390c61: Purpose: Repro of O1 bug 1 (stale helper node counters) over UCI. After a deep multi-thread search the helpers' published node counts stay at their final values. At the next `go nodes N`, the main thread checks the node budget at every node and sums those stale counts before the helpers have reset them, so the search stops before depth 1 completes and the engine plays the first legal move unsearched (no info line). Works on the AL1 s198 lock exe; on the O1 build compare SmpExactNodes=false/true. usage: r. Functions: main. Data: KIWI. Python, 47 lines.
summaries.1441dd46f811ff65541103e8e33666d26493f4dd: Purpose: Lazy SMP scaling table (O1): for each thread count, R runs of `go depth D` over the position set (fresh ucinewgame per position, Hash 16 by default). Time-to-depth = wall time from `go` to `bestmove`; NPS = nodes of the last info line / that time. Prints raw per-run totals, then per thread count: mean total time-to-depth, speedup vs the first thread count, mean NPS, NPS scaling, and the node overhead (searched nodes vs the first thread count). usage: scaling.py <engine> --positions <file> [--ski. Functions: main. Python, 84 lines.

summaries.6c64bcb99910a26f7c9e4af19a8e2378b8f35af5: Purpose: Trainer for Forge's NNUE evaluation. Architecture (per side-to-move perspective): 768 piece-square inputs -> Hidden accumulator, SCReLU activation, then a single output over both perspectives (2 * Hidden -> 1). Trained with Adam on the squared error between sigmoid(output) and a blend of game result and search score, using the same "<fen> <result> <score>" files that forge_texel consumes. Usage: forge_nnue_train positions.txt [more.txt ...] [--epochs N] [--lr X] [--lambda L] [--batch B] [--threa. Types: struct Sample, struct Network, struct Gradients, struct Adam. Functions: randomize, rng, load, in, save, out, clear, sigmoid, train_sample, Adam, step, write_include, main, fields, adam_w1. Data: Inputs, Hidden. C++, 371 lines.
summaries.0ebc09b415851fefc5fc156205ed872ef9d459bc: Purpose: Texel-style evaluation tuner. Reads positions produced by forge_extract ("<fen> <result> <score>"), builds the linear coefficient trace of every position once, then fits all evaluation parameters with Adam on the mean squared error between the sigmoid of the evaluation and a blend of game result and search score. Usage: forge_texel positions.txt [--epochs N] [--lr X] [--lambda L] [--threads T] [--min-count C] [--decay-every D] [--reg R] [--rarity F] [--out table.inc] forge_texel --dump table.inc.
